# Keys read from the rune of an event, accepted by TestTUIKeysGoThroughKeys
# (internal/archtest/tui_keys_test.go).
#
# One line per file: "<file> <count>". The list only shrinks: a new key read
# from a rune fails the test, and so does a count that went down (or a file
# with none left) until its line is updated here or removed. Never raise a
# count to make the test pass: ask a key of internal/tui/v2/keys
# (keys.Delete.Matches(event), keys.Toggle…) or declare the letter of the view
# with keys.Own.
#
# Empty since the lot A12 (v5.1): every key of internal/tui and cmd/tui_*.go
# goes through keys.
